Validation_Type.reason: The reader's report is right. The graph-based deep model (GBDM) classifies MCI vs NC on 214 ADNI subjects (116 NC / 98 MCI; sMRI + rs-fMRI + DTI) and is evaluated by 5-fold cross-validation (p.7). The same 5-fold scheme is used for every hyper-parameter setting (p.10). There is no held-out test partition. The only evaluation scheme described is 5-fold CV, and the 'testing dataset' loss and accuracy curves in Fig. 10 (p.14) are never described as a separate hold-out set. The 'Reproducibility and generalizability' analysis (p.14) takes 124 subjects from 28 other ADNI centres and re-runs the method with its own 5-fold CV. That is a within-ADNI replication by retraining, not a test of the trained model on data from another institution, and ADNI is a single consortium. So V3 and V4 do not apply, and V1 does not apply either (5-fold, n = 214). V2 = k-fold CV on the same dataset with no separate test set. 'not reported' is out of vocabulary and is contradicted by the explicitly reported 5-fold CV.
